## MiniMax H3 Max Turbo (API) - MinimaxHailuo03TextToVideoNode
**Estimated cost per run: $0.286 USD = about 60.3 Comfy credits** (211 credits per USD, https://www.comfy.org/cloud/pricing).

Price badge: 768P x 5 s x $0.0572/s. Cheapest tier that reaches 720p or more (480P is below 720p; 'MiniMax H3' flagship 768P would be $0.6435; 2K much higher).

**Differs from the shared options**
- Resolution: 768P (16:9) only, no 720P option -> not exactly 1280x720.
- Duration 5 s (min 5 for Max Turbo). Frame rate/frame count are chosen by the service.
- No negative prompt input. Seed is accepted but results are only similar.
- prompt_expansion_mode = balanced: the service may rewrite the prompt a little. No audio option; the node exposes no audio toggle.

## Kling 3.0 (API) - KlingVideoNode (kling-v3)
**Estimated cost per run: $0.42 USD = about 88.6 Comfy credits** (211 credits per USD, https://www.comfy.org/cloud/pricing).

Price badge: 720p, audio off, 5 s x $0.084/s (audio on would be $0.126/s; 1080p $0.112/s). Audio is turned OFF to lower the cost.
Why KlingVideoNode and not KlingOmniProTextToVideoNode: it is the main Kling 3.0 text/image-to-video node (model kling-v3) with a real negative prompt field and multi_shot=disabled for a plain single shot; the Omni node costs the same at 720p but is the reference/edit-oriented node and has no separate negative prompt.

**Differs from the shared options**
- Seed is accepted but results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.
- Resolution 720p 16:9 (should be 1280x720; fps chosen by the service).

## LTX-2.5 22B distilled (open model, runs on Comfy Cloud GPU)
Based on the official ComfyUI template **video_ltx2_5_t2v** (Text to Video LTX-2.5; subgraph unpacked into plain nodes). Cloud file names: ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16, ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16, ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16, gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16, ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.

- Two-stage: first stage at half size, latent x2 upscaler, second stage. Audio is generated too and kept in the saved clip.
- **5 s = 121 frames at 24 fps** (length = duration x fps + 1, as in the template).
- **Size: shared 1280x720 is fed in, but LTX works in multiples of 32 (EmptyLTXVLatentVideo uses height // 32), so the output is 1280x704.**
- Optional 'prompt enhancement' (gemma e2b rewrites the prompt) was removed from the template so every model sees the identical prompt.
- Distilled model runs at CFG 1, so the negative prompt has no effect (it is wired anyway). Seed feeds the first-stage RandomNoise.
- Billing: Comfy Cloud GPU time (no API credits). Not measured here; see https://www.comfy.org/cloud/pricing for GPU rates.
nodes.title: Notes: LTX-2.5 22B distilled (open model)

## Wan 2.2 14B T2V (open model, runs on Comfy Cloud GPU)
Based on the official ComfyUI template **video_wan2_2_14B_t2v** (subgraph unpacked into plain nodes). Files: wan2.2_t2v_high/low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled, umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled, wan_2.1_vae.

- **5 s = 81 frames at 16 fps** (floor(duration x fps) + 1 = 81 -> 5.06 s).
- **'Enable Lightning LoRA' is switched ON** (4-step lightx2v LoRA, 4 steps, CFG 1) so class runs are fast. The official template ships with it OFF (20 steps, CFG 3.5); switch the boolean off for the original look.
- Size: shared 1280x720 (template default is 640x640; 720p is slower and needs more VRAM).
- At CFG 1 the negative prompt has no effect (it is wired anyway). No audio.
- Billing: Comfy Cloud GPU time (no API credits). Not measured here; see https://www.comfy.org/cloud/pricing for GPU rates.

## Comparison sheet (optional)
Every clip is cut to its first 5 s, sampled to exactly 120 frames (24 fps x 5 s), fitted into a 480x270 cell (black bars if the aspect differs) with the model name under it, then tiled 3 x 3 (legend card + 8 clips) into one silent 24 fps video: ~1448x930.

Switching a branch off: select that branch's group and press Ctrl+B. Its cell stays empty (black) and the sheet still builds - ImageStitch image2 is optional. Never bypass only the generator node; bypass the whole group.

Because the sheet frames are sampled by index, a clip's real speed is kept only when it is close to 5 s (Veo 3.1 Lite is cut from 6 s to the first 5 s; Wan 2.2 is 5.06 s). Not executed or tested here (no runs were queued).
nodes.title: Notes: comparison sheet

widgets_values:
## 5-second video model comparison (text to video only)
One prompt, one negative prompt, one seed, one 16:9 size feed every branch. Run all, or press **Ctrl+B on a branch's group** to switch that model off. Each branch saves its own clip as `compare/<model>`; the sheet is `compare/sheet`.

**Shared options and what each model can take**
- Size: 1280x720 for Wan 2.2, Kling (720p), Veo (720p), Seedance (720p), Wan 2.7 (720P), Grok (720p). LTX-2.5 outputs 1280x704 (multiples of 32). MiniMax H3 only has 768P/2K, so 768P.
- Length: 5 s everywhere except Veo (4/6/8 s only -> 6 s used).
- Seed: honoured by LTX, Wan 2.2 (open) and by MiniMax/Veo/Wan 2.7 (similar results); Kling, Seedance and Grok ignore it for determinism.
- Negative prompt: LTX/Wan 2.2 (no effect at CFG 1), Kling, Veo, Wan 2.7. Not available on MiniMax, Seedance, Grok.

**Cost per full run (API estimates from each node's price badge)**
- MiniMax H3 Max Turbo: $0.286 (~60.3 credits)
- Kling 3.0: $0.42 (~88.6 credits)
- Veo 3.1 Lite: $0.18 (~38.0 credits)
- Seedance 2.5: $1.67 (~351.6 credits)
- Wan 2.7: $0.5 (~105.5 credits)
- Grok Imagine 1.5 Lite: $0.214 (~45.3 credits)
- All 6 API branches: $3.27 (~689.3 credits), 211 credits per USD (https://www.comfy.org/cloud/pricing).
- LTX-2.5 and Wan 2.2 bill Comfy Cloud GPU time instead (not measured).

The sheet is optional: bypass the 'Comparison sheet' group if you only want the clips.
